# Model card for mike (medium)

* Language: en_US (English, United States)
* Speakers: 1
* Quality: medium
* Samplerate: 22,050Hz

## Dataset

* URL: https://github.com/OHF-Voice/voice-datasets
* License: CC0

## Training

Finetuned from the rdh base model (medium quality; nl_BE, one Flemish speaker, CC0), with MRD and SDP.

Default inference settings are noise_scale 0.5 and noise_w 0.333.

Requires Piper 1.5 or higher.

# Model card for reza_ibrahim

* Language: fa_IR/en_US (Persian, Iran)/(English, US)
* Speakers: 1
* Quality: medium
* Samplerate: 22,050Hz

## Dataset

* URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mah92/Hedayatfar-Persian-Quran-Audio-Dataset
* URL2: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mah92/Ibrahim-Walk-English-Quran-Audio-Dataset

* License: CC0

## Training

Finetuned from U.S. English lessac voice (medium quality).

## Credits

Dataset by RezaHedayatfar and IbrahimWalk.
Trained by Ali Mahmoudi (@mah92)
